why_panic_arms_flip_at_ctfe_only: A POPULATION difference, not a gate difference. record_green is the sole registry writer for BOTH seams and consults markers_exact identically. Of the 39 agreed assert-carrying bodies, 23 are markers_exact and all 23 are const initializers passing VACUOUSLY over two empty marker sequences; the runtime assert-carrying bodies are refused by the func.scopes firewall or by operands_of and never reach the gate.

cost.headline: A5 as first written DID NOT BUILD: Specification::new() ran 2572.7 s and then failed with a type mismatch. It is restated as an INSTANCE of a lemma proved at two free variables and the statement is unchanged character for character. What remains is ir_mt_exact, and the whole of it is one comparison that no spelling can avoid.

a5_first_shape.error: Type mismatch: expected Eq Nat env_push_low_local_meta_tag k, got Eq Nat (ir_outcome_nat (IROutcome.ret (ir_vl1 (IRScalar.int_ env_push_low_local_meta_tag)))) (ir_outcome_nat (IROutcome.ret (ir_vl1 (IRScalar.int_ k))))
a5_first_shape.mechanism: NOT that ir_outcome_nat fails to reduce. It weak-head-normalizes to K in a few iota steps, and whnf does not STOP at K: K is a definition, so reduction continues into ir_wrap ir_d64 (ir_nat_mul ir_d1 (ir_nat_pow2 63)), and ir_nat_mul recurses on its SECOND argument. Every chain from the second onward makes this move inside its own A5 and gets away with it because its answer carries a FREE VARIABLE. This is the first chain whose answer is CLOSED.
a5_first_shape.probe_seconds: does not finish; killed at 600 s

a5_restated.shape: ir_ret_int_nat (read-back at a variable) + ir_ret_int_inj (inversion at two variables); ir_mt_machine_sound is the instance at (K, k)
a5_restated.shapes_weighed_and_rejected: The fifth chain's PATH-witness technique (for when a concrete witness is unreachable; here it is reachable and executed, ir_mt_w_runs, so a path statement would weaken A5 for nothing) and stating the conclusion in ir_outcome_nat form (the `got` type: type-checks trivially and is NOT A5 -- it says two projections agree and leaves the reader to perform the one reduction nothing can perform).

second_failure_repairing_a5_exposed.why_never_seen: the build died at A5 first, so no run had ever reached it
second_failure_repairing_a5_exposed.mechanism: ir_int_cmp canonicalizes both operands through ir_wrap, whose ir_nat_rem -> ir_div_go recursion is on the QUOTIENT. At width 8 on the operand 2147483648 that is 2^31/2^8 = 8,388,608 loop steps.

seconds_by_declared_width.8: 166.55 in the full spec / 167.26 in the probe, and then FAILS

second_failure_repairing_a5_exposed.repair: stated at width 16, where the quotient is 32,768 and the contrast is identical because 2^31 is 0 modulo 2^16 exactly as it is modulo 2^8; PAIRED with the new ir_mt_icmp_at_the_bodys_width_is_false, which executes the other side of the contrast at the width the shipped body declares.

no_rhs_spelling_can_help.conclusion: There is no congruence step and no lazy-delta short-circuit: the moment the two sides are not byte-identical the kernel normalizes. This closes the question the earlier `three spellings, all ~360 s` observation left open -- the spelling was never the variable.

ir_mt_exact.named_build_item: Route ir_shl_bits through ir_nat_shl (registered by the 2026-08-16 bits lane: m*2^k as k STRICT doublings, linear in k where ir_nat_mul m (ir_nat_pow2 k) is linear in 2^k). It needs the GENERAL equation ir_nat_shl m k = ir_nat_mul m (ir_nat_pow2 k); what exists today is one kernel-executed witness at (3, 10), ir_nat_shl_mul_w. A build item for its own lane. A lowering gap is a build item, never a reason to retarget the proof.
